cases.title: Answered artifact boundary should not be asked again
cases.prompt: 帮我做一个管理后台系统

prompt_sequence.content: 帮我做一个管理后台系统

prompt_sequence.content_contains: 这次要交付的是网页应用、后端 API、本地脚本，还是完整业务系统？

required_evidence: context-debug summary shows answered clarification with answer 网页应用
context-debug summary pending clarification is empty
The same artifact boundary question appears only once after the answer
hard_fail_rules: Agent repeats the same artifact boundary question after user answers 网页应用
User answer 网页应用 is treated as an unrelated new task
Pending clarification remains open after answer
expected: Close the artifact_type clarification after the user answer
Continue execution or ask only a new materially different clarification
Preserve the original request and answer in compiled context
forbidden: Repeat the same delivery type question
Block the next model call on stale pending clarification
Use UI projection or Redis as the fact source

cases.title: Follow-up delegated plan should inherit previous project goal
cases.prompt: 按你的想法，先帮我做个方案

prompt_sequence.content: A prior turn completed or progressed a 管理后台系统 request after the user answered 网页应用
按你的想法，先帮我做个方案

required_evidence: context-debug summary recentIntent includes the original admin system request, 网页应用, and this follow-up
No new duplicate artifact_type clarification appears
Agent produces or starts producing a plan for the previous 管理后台系统
hard_fail_rules: Agent asks again whether the deliverable is 网页应用、后端 API、本地脚本 or 完整业务系统
Agent treats 方案 as a context-free task
Agent outputs only a generic clarification template and does not advance
expected: Inherit the 管理后台系统 + 网页应用 context
Produce a plan or plan document
forbidden: Change deliverable type without user request

cases.title: Low-information continuation should use prior context

prompt_sequence.content: A prior turn has a clear active goal and no pending clarification

hard_fail_rules: Agent asks an already answered clarification again
expected: Continue from the latest active goal
Ask only if a real pending confirmation exists
forbidden: Treat 继续 as a new standalone task
Use a fixed clarification template without context

cases.title: Explicit target override should supersede prior delivery type
cases.prompt: 不要网页了，改成本地脚本

prompt_sequence.content: A prior turn established 网页应用 as the delivery type
不要网页了，改成本地脚本

required_evidence: context-debug summary recentIntent includes the override
Agent does not force the old 网页应用 target
hard_fail_rules: Agent continues webpage implementation after the explicit override
Agent loses the override from context-debug recent intent
expected: Treat 本地脚本 as the latest target
Ask a focused follow-up only if needed for script scope
forbidden: Old clarification answer locks the task forever

cases.title: Tool failure should be visible to the next model turn
cases.prompt: 生成一个网页应用并运行检查
required_evidence: Failed tool result is present in tool result envelope
Agent retry or explanation references the failure
hard_fail_rules: Agent behaves as if the failed tool did not happen
Failed tool call has no tool_result equivalent
expected: Persist failed tool result into context
Continue with retry or explain the blocker

cases.title: Dynamic context should not mutate stable prompt state
cases.prompt: 基于附件和已选 skill 继续处理
required_evidence: Dynamic context is represented as typed context blocks
Stable system hash stays unchanged when only dynamic context changes
Relevant dynamic hash changes are visible
hard_fail_rules: Attachments, skills, or MCP state are flattened into unstable system prompt text
Redis or UI projection becomes the context fact source
expected: Use typed context blocks for attachments, skills, MCP, memory
